name: Participation 6
definition: Provide information on the level of participation to a shareholder meeting.

TotalNumberOfVotingRights.name: Total Number Of Voting Rights
TotalNumberOfVotingRights.definition: Number of rights admitted to the vote.

PercentageOfVotingRights.name: Percentage Of Voting Rights
PercentageOfVotingRights.definition: Percentage of rights participating to the vote versus total voting rights.

TotalNumberOfSecuritiesOutstanding.name: Total Number Of Securities Outstanding
TotalNumberOfSecuritiesOutstanding.definition: Number of securities admitted to the vote, expressed as a number of units or a face amount.

CalculationDate.name: Calculation Date
CalculationDate.definition: Date of calculation of the total number of outstanding securities.
